The Trigger.dev Management API provides comprehensive REST endpoints for managing workflow runs, tasks, schedules, deployments, queues, environment variables, batches, and waitpoints. Enables programmatic control over the full lifecycle of background job workflows including triggering, monitoring, cancellation, and observability. Authenticated via bearer token (secret API key starting with tr_dev_, tr_prod_, or tr_stg_).
